conclusion: Identical cold-boot failure with the branch-2 IOP INIT send in the executed path: firmware crashes during boot, no namespace, -62. Same-session m1n1 history (a clean init/read/shutdown cycle minutes earlier) does not save the Linux cold boot, eliminating session history for the cold path as well. One concrete reset difference remains: DT exposes only &ps_ans as the NVMe reset while m1n1's proven cycle resets ANS and ANS2; whether ps_ans covers ANS2 is the next desk check. The warm sleep crash is a separate window and remains explained by none of the above; E5 is its remaining test.
